I'm delighted to partner with @LaudeInstitute (along with my @Sanjay_Ghemawat, John Hennessy, Dave Patterson, Ben Gomes and @andykonwinski) to support funding of open science moonshots!

anyone who is close to research knows how broken the incentives are. doing open science at the frontier is harder than ever, compute costs alone price most teams out. we kept wondering what might happen if we give the right resources to the right researchers at the right time?
